# Skill: Incident Response Runbook

## Content

1. Acknowledge the alert and name an incident lead.
2. Stabilize first: roll back or disable the failing change.
3. Communicate status every 30 minutes in the incident channel.
4. Write a blameless postmortem within three working days.
